function.name: current_weather_condition
function.description: Get the current weather conditions of a specific city including temperature and humidity.

city.description: The city that you want to get the current weather conditions for.

country.description: The country of the city you specified.

measurement.description: You can specify which unit to display the temperature in, 'c' for Celsius, 'f' for Fahrenheit. Default is 'c'.
